description: Protect /remote-build: user-typed only; hosts resolved by hostname with a stable host-key alias; pre-flight refuses a dirty checkout or a second heavy build; the build runs detached with a done-file; artifacts are hashed and version-checked; copies are hash-verified on each target; each target install needs its own yes; no install that kills the hosting session; no edits to ssh config, sshd or firewall.
must_contain:
It does not
approve installing: each target PC's install is its own yes
**A timeout is not proof the PC is down.**
never stash or reset someone's work.

Delete an old
  done-file before starting
A copy that returned no error isn't proof.
wait for the user's yes for **that** PC.
don't run an install that replaces the app hosting this session
Install on a PC the user didn't approve in this run
Edit `~/.ssh/config`, `known_hosts`, `sshd_config`, firewall rules or another PC's settings
